source_text:
21.19 Αὐτοὶ δὲ κατενόησαν, καὶ ἐπεῖ δόν με. Ψηλαφῶντες,
κατὰ τὸ εἰκὸς, α παν αὐτοῦ τὸ σῶμα καὶ ἀναμετροῦντες ε καστον τῶν ὀστέων, ι να
ι δοιεν ου τοὺς η λους πῆξαι χρή.
pass_a_gloss: They and considered, and they-looked-upon me. Feeling, according-to the likely, all of-him the body and measuring each of-the bones, that they-might-see where the nails to-fix it-is-necessary.
pass_b_english: “And they considered, and they looked upon me” (Psalm 21:19).
Feeling, as is likely, his whole body and measuring each of the bones, that they might see where they must fix the nails.

choices.term: ἵνα ἴδοιεν οὓς ἥλους πῆξαι χρή
choices.english: that they might see where they must fix the nails
choices.why: OCR ι να ι δοιεν ου τοὺς η λους. The look is to place the nails of the passion, not a mere medical count.
rejected: they counted bones for a census
they refused to look at him

anf_compare.notes: ANF lacks this Greek catena as reading English.
